title: DelegationInvite
description: Admin-visible metadata for a delegation invite. The invite token is never returned by API.

x-enumDescriptions: Valid and not yet used; can be resent or revoked.
Revoked by customer admin; cannot be used.
Expired by TTL; cannot be used.
Consumed by an MSP; cannot be used again.

allowedScopes.description: Upper bound of scopes that may be granted when accepted.

mspOrgSlug.description: Optional target MSP org slug (equals Organization.slug, immutable). If omitted, invite is open.

sentAt.description: When the most recent email was sent, if any.

usedAt.description: When the invite was consumed (for audit).
